vulnerabilities.title: Log4Shell: JNDI lookup in log message substitution
vulnerabilities.description: Attacker-controlled log messages are passed through StrSubstitutor, which can resolve ${jndi:...} and load remote code.

vulnerabilities.title: SnakeYAML Constructor deserialization RCE

sinks.note: instantiates the class named by a !!tag in the document

vulnerabilities.description: The default Constructor instantiates classes named in the YAML document, letting a crafted document construct arbitrary objects.

vulnerabilities.title: Commons Collections InvokerTransformer deserialization gadget

sinks.note: invokes an arbitrary method on the transformed object

vulnerabilities.description: InvokerTransformer allows arbitrary method invocation and is the core gadget primitive in the commons-collections deserialization chain.

vulnerabilities.title: XStream remote code execution via crafted XML

sinks.note: instantiates the class named in the XML

vulnerabilities.description: Unmarshalling XML with XStream instantiates classes named by the document, enabling arbitrary code execution.
